pokedexEntries.ru: LINOONE always runs full speed and only in straight lines. If facing an obstacle, it makes a right-angle turn to evade it. This POKéMON is very challenged by gently curving roads.

pokedexEntries.sa: When hunting, LINOONE will make a beeline straight for the prey at a full run. While this POKéMON is capable of topping 60 mph, it has to come to a screeching halt before it can turn.

pokedexEntries.frlg: When running in a straight line, it can top 60 miles per hour. However, it has a tough time with curved roads.

pokedexEntries.em: It is exceedingly fast if it only has to run in a straight line. When it spots pond-dwelling prey underwater, it quickly leaps in and catches it with its sharp claws.

pokedexEntries.dpp: It charges prey at speeds over 60 mph. However, because it can only run straight, it often fails.

pokedexEntries.hgss: When running in a straight line, it can easily top 60 miles an hour. It has a tough time with curved roads.
